settings.forwardImport.confirm:
The package will completely replace your current libraries, home layouts, modules, viewing history, and app preferences. Existing data absent from the package will not be kept. Supported library login credentials will be imported; the installation account and device identity will remain unchanged.

When finished, the window will flip directly to the imported home screen without restarting. On failure, the original data will be restored. Syncable data will be scheduled to overwrite Rex’s iCloud data according to your current settings.
